saddle-stitch.blurb: Folded sheets stapled through the fold, so it opens flat and weighs almost nothing. No spine to print on, and thin books only.

perfect-bound.blurb: Pages glued into a flat printed spine, like any trade paperback. Needs enough thickness to glue.

coil-bound.blurb: A spiral through punched holes, so the book lies perfectly flat on a table. Made for reading along and coloring in; it won't look like a trade book.

casewrap.blurb: Artwork printed straight onto the board and laminated. The keepsake format, and what a gift copy should be.

print.label: Interior printing
print.hint: How the pages are printed. The biggest lever on price for a long book.

paper.label: Paper
paper.hint: What the pages are printed on.

premium-colour.label: Premium color
premium-colour.hint: Richest color and the sharpest registration. What illustrated pages are worth, and the provider's own pick for children's books.

standard-colour.label: Standard color
standard-colour.hint: Color on every page at about a third of the premium price per page. Colors read a little flatter.

premium-bw.label: Premium black & white
premium-bw.hint: Deep blacks and fine grays for pencil and ink work. Illustrations print as monochrome.

standard-bw.label: Standard black & white
standard-bw.hint: The cheapest way to print a long book. Right for text-led chapter books, wrong for color art.

80-coated-white.label: 80# coated white
80-coated-white.hint: Heavy and smooth with a slight sheen, so colors pop. The provider's recommendation for picture books.

60-uncoated-white.label: 60# uncoated white
60-uncoated-white.hint: Lighter and matte, more like a novel. Softer color, thinner and cheaper book.

60-uncoated-cream.label: 60# uncoated cream
60-uncoated-cream.hint: Warm off-white that is gentler to read against. Black & white interiors only — the provider prints no color on cream.

gloss.label: Gloss
gloss.hint: Shiny and saturated, and wipes clean — which matters for a book toddlers hold. Shows fingerprints.

matte.label: Matte
matte.hint: Soft, low-glare and reads as more premium. Marks show more easily than gloss.

how.heading: From bedtime idea to real book in three steps
how.subhead: A guided journey from your imagination to a finished, printable book - no design skills required.

step1.title: Shape your story
step1.body: Write your own words or let our guided storytelling spark an adventure made just for your little reader.

step2.title: Bring scenes to life
step2.body: Choose an art style. Your characters stay consistent across every illustration, from cover to final page.

step3.title: Print & cherish
step3.body: Preview your complete book, customize your layout, and order a hardcover delivered to your door.

features.heading: Why parents & kids love our books
features.subhead: Crafted with love, built for bedtime, and printed to last generations.

0.title: 100% customizable stories
0.body: Every page is fully yours to shape. Personalize names, choose your art style, and fine-tune every sentence and illustration until it feels just right.

1.title: Digital, print, or both
1.body: Read together on your tablet or smartphone right away, order a real physical book delivered to your home, or enjoy both seamlessly.

2.title: Softcover or heirloom hardcover
2.body: Select the perfect format for your family: a durable, flexible softcover for everyday reading, or a sturdy library-grade hardcover keepsake.

3.title: Digital edition included
3.body: Every book comes with an instant high-resolution digital edition. Read together on your iPad or share with distant grandparents.

4.title: Zero setup, start creating
4.body: Start creating immediately with no sign-up wall. Preview your storybook for free.

5.title: Flexible options
5.body: Order single printed books on demand, or join a membership for monthly savings.

founder.quote: When my toddler needed surgery, I couldn't find a single picture book gentle enough to help him understand what was about to happen. So I made one myself - and that book became Childbook Studio.
